name: round3
rule: Cell S, side A, hashed before any score. k01-k10 and the 18 audit looks count in N whether run or not (N = 192). S has been read by 36 trials, so a pass is weaker evidence than a round-1 pass. Bar unchanged: R-SLEEVE3 and PBO < 0.5 (evaluation/pbo.py, blocks = 16, over round 1's 22 columns, round 2's 8 and k01-k10). k06-k08 start 2013-01-01 with the split 2015-01-01 unchanged, and are zero-filled earlier in the PBO matrix. Any pass is audited (oracle, reversed, one-day shift, cost check) before it is believed. A defect voids the trial, with no re-score. One candidate is frozen: the single survivor, or the better of t1/t2 by selection Sharpe. Zero survivors: verdict at once, no freeze, no holdout read. Then R-HOLD1 once, then R-LEAN21 and R-EDGE2 unchanged.
bar: Net of costs and financing, on strategy_excess (sessions at 252 unless crypto-only), median of 5 phases, in its selection cell: clears min_live_names; Sharpe >= 0.40 in both halves and pooled >= 0.50; rank-IC non-overlapping t >= 2.0 (not for no_ic_clause); p < 0.05 against each null of nulls_for, 100 placebos each, run only for trials passing the earlier clauses. Among survivors, daily correlation > 0.7 drops the lower Sharpe; at most 5 remain. Zero survivors: verdict at once.
pbo_rule: evaluation/pbo.py with blocks=16 over pbo_columns on cell S. PBO >= 0.5 or None: verdict at once, no retry. Crypto trials and w13 are on other windows, and t1/t2 are built from survivors; they are outside the matrix.

k01.why: w04 is the one premium that kept a positive IC in all 8 years; each sector was given gross 1 whatever its size, which is the book's real inefficiency

k02.why: r03 was the best net score, 0.57; its second half fell to 0.21

k03.why: a residual against beta, size and volatility should cost little Sharpe if the premium is not those exposures

k04.tests: k02 at a third of the cost
k04.why: these are slow signals; costs took about a third of w04's gross Sharpe

k05.why: the first model that reads only years holding its inputs: m2-m4 trained from 2004 on features 19 names had in 2009

k06.tests: a small tree held to published signs
k06.why: interactions without the freedom to learn a premium backward

k07.tests: the installed network family, on the fundamentals era
k07.runs_if: k05's mean rank IC is above 0; counted regardless
k07.why: the network the project ships, given inputs it can learn from; if the linear model finds nothing, the network has nothing to find

k08.tests: a fixed ensemble of the models

k09.why: w04 read annual filings, up to 15 months stale; the literature's accruals are quarterly

k10.why: net operating assets and capital spending are the investment side of accruals, and no earlier trial held them

disclosures: Cell S has been read by 36 trials, and these ten are chosen with that knowledge.
The model audit looked at six feature groups at three horizons on S before this file was written. The trials were fixed in the phase plan before it ran, and it added none.

Filings before about 2011 are sparse (19 names in 2009, 292 in 2010, 466 in 2011), so k05 leans on its sign prior in its first year and k06-k08 only begin in 2013, leaving two years in their first half.
k09 and k10 read a quarterly and annual download made in this phase, which uses today's list of tickers, as every fundamentals trial has.
The holdouts stay closed unless the gate leaves a survivor.
